result.title: Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret
result.summary: Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. We instead propose a DFL framework that achieves risk-sensitive behavior while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization at inference time. Starting from the dual representation of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) and adding entropy regularization, we derive a smooth surrogate for the CVaR of regret. Its gradient induces an instance-dependent reweighting within each minibatch that emphasizes high-risk outcomes, so the approach can turn existing surrogate-loss DFL methods, including the SPO+ loss, into risk-sensitive variants. When instantiated with SPO+, the resulting objective admits a generalization bound on the CVaR of the true regret. Experiments on knapsack, portfolio, shortest-path, and energy-aware scheduling problems show substantial reductions in tail regret when the uncertain parameters exhibit heterogeneous tail behavior.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种风险敏感的 decision-focused learning 框架：从 CVaR 的对偶表示加熵正则导出光滑的 regret-CVaR 代理目标，其梯度在小批量内产生实例依赖重加权，从而把 SPO+ 等现有代理损失改造为风险敏感版本，同时推理时仍只做点预测与确定性优化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按风险对样本重加权」的训练监督思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练的贡献分配与高风险样本（如 LOOK/STOP 决策）加权问题，但与原论文的多模态推理主线无直接关联。
